headline: AI Stocks Lifted
detail: Micron, Intel, and other AI-related stocks are seeing gains. This could provide a temporary boost to some of your tech holdings, but the broader trend for leveraged ETFs remains concerning.
rec: Monitor if this AI lift extends to your specific holdings, but don't chase leveraged names.

headline: Cybersecurity Stocks Rebound
detail: Investors are returning to cybersecurity after recent outages. This sector is showing resilience, which could be a diversification play if you decide to trim tech exposure.
rec: Consider if any cybersecurity names present a compelling setup if you rotate out of underperforming tech.

headline: Anthropic IPO and AI in Finance
detail: The upcoming Anthropic IPO and AI's increasing presence in financial plans highlight the ongoing AI investment theme. This reinforces the sector's importance but also the speculative nature of some AI plays.
rec: This headline reinforces the AI theme but doesn't provide a specific actionable trade for your current book.
